title: Paired direct/planner protocol parity on synthetic CPU inputs

checks.command: PYTHONUTF8=1 python -I -m unittest discover -s language_growth/tests -t . -p test_paired_comparison.py -v

protocol_regressions.extra_ssdm_key: Direct arm provider_error/invalid_response, one direct call and one forward; planner arm remains correct; pair stays in denominator and is incorrect.
protocol_regressions.invalid_parent_pin: Direct and planner arms precondition_failed/invalid_served_config_pin with zero provider and forward calls; pair stays in denominator and is incorrect.
protocol_regressions.shared_checks: Direct arm uses planner _Session no-call preflight and _RESPONSE_ENVELOPE_KEYS.

scope: Synthetic scripted protocol validation only; no learned or retention-gate result.
